name: Bandits
snippet: **01-08** **Bandits, x 1-4** and **1 Bandit Lieutenant.** These evil humans prowl the Old Castle Track seeking to ambush travelers.
source: CnC Docs/02 CZ Ruins Mouths of Madness.md

name: Brigands
snippet: **09-15** **Brigands, x 7-12 (includes 1 serjeant).** These humans are either mounted or afoot, out pretending to be something they are not (soldiers, hunters, trappers, etc).
source: CnC Docs/02 CZ Ruins Mouths of Madness.md

name: Black bear (small)
snippet: **16-20** **Black bear (small) x 1**. Roll on Sub-table 1. and Sub-table 2. for activity and condition.
source: CnC Docs/02 CZ Ruins Mouths of Madness.md

name: Bugbears
snippet: **21-25** **Bugbears, x 1-3.** Out hunting.
source: CnC Docs/02 CZ Ruins Mouths of Madness.md

name: Gnolls
snippet: **26-30** **Gnolls, x 2.** Out patrolling, their camp located in the depths of the Little Hillwood.
source: CnC Docs/02 CZ Ruins Mouths of Madness.md

name: Goblin patrol

snippet: **61-70 Snake, poisonous, x 1.** Slithering through the underbrush and across the track; an encounter indicating that the reptile has either been stepped on or near enough to provoke attack; otherwise it slithers away.
source: CnC Docs/02 CZ Ruins Mouths of Madness.md

name: Stirges
